cases.given: Valid Q01 with a foreign frame
cases.expected: UNTRUSTED_SENDER; no Host call; requestId not reflected

cases.given: Trusted card A asks to confirm asset B
cases.expected: SCOPE_DENIED; no evidence read or write

cases.given: Library generation changes after validation but before transaction
cases.expected: LIBRARY_SCOPE_CHANGED; no commit to new library

cases.given: Evidence preview/revision no longer matches active asset
cases.expected: SUGGESTION_UNAVAILABLE; no tag relation added

cases.given: Same selected suggestion clicked twice with fresh request IDs
cases.expected: One confirmed relation; both successful states allowed; requestId is not idempotency authority

cases.given: Transaction commits; event notification throws
cases.expected: R02 ok=true; no second mutation; old caller sees success

cases.given: Inject storage failure with verified transaction rollback
cases.expected: STORAGE_WRITE_FAILED; not-committed; no automatic retry

cases.given: Reply transport drops after commit boundary; client cannot know result
cases.expected: Client reconciliation state; do not synthesize a received server trace or replay blindly

cases.given: Owner scope revoked before commit admission
cases.expected: CANCELLED or scope conflict per observed cause; no commit

cases.given: Owner revocation arrives after transaction commit
cases.expected: Do not undo or label committed result cancelled; suppress stale UI application

cases.given: Host typed opening/busy state before any write
cases.expected: waiting kind; after-condition; recheck scope before any subsequent explicit request

cases.given: Legacy confirmTag success bridge
cases.expected: Electron JS result retains ok=true and value===undefined; never manufacture null

cases.given: Only an old generic error string is available
cases.expected: Never infer permission/retry from localized text; use phase-known INTERNAL_FAILURE or indeterminate

cases.given: Q20 with 41 supplementary codepoints
cases.expected: Shape accepted; compatibility validator rejects >80 UTF16 units for new sample; no silent slicing

cases.given: Both validators consume exact contract-cases.json and same schema digests
cases.expected: Every expectedSchemaValid and verdict match; no bool/number/string coercion

cases.given: A worker returns schema-valid IDs suggesting a confirmation
cases.expected: IPC sender still denied; conformance execution does not grant worker mutation API

cases.given: R13 valid shape but different assetId
cases.expected: Client pair guard rejects reply binding; no assertion server write rolled back

cases.given: Q02 on the new channel
cases.expected: UNSUPPORTED_VERSION using v1 supported error shell; no lower-version execution/fallback

cases.given: Failures containing sentinel secret, tag, path and receipt
cases.expected: No sentinel in trace or safeMessage; only allowlisted metadata

cases.given: TS imports/exports and Python imports are rewired in an isolated fixture
cases.expected: AST rule catches forbidden edge; runtime Host spy verifies zero unauthorized calls; static scan alone not permission proof
